critical_findings.title: Wrong map loaded in Phase L
critical_findings.description: Phase L validated the built-in CARLA map Town10HD_Opt instead of the accepted Ingolstadt candidate raw_xodr_run_1_epsg32632_header_pinned.xodr
critical_findings.impact: Phase L L_ALL_PASS verdict is invalid - the wrong map was validated

critical_findings.title: Road count discrepancy unexplained
critical_findings.description: The campaign reports 32,710 roads but Phase L reported 88 roads (from topology segments). The runtime OpenDRIVE has 108 roads. Neither matches the campaign figure.

evidence.explanation: Phase L L6 counted unique road_ids from CARLA topology segments, not total roads in OpenDRIVE

critical_findings.impact: The road count metric used in Phase L is semantically different from the campaign metric

critical_findings.title: Junction count discrepancy unexplained
critical_findings.description: The campaign reports 3,646 junctions but Phase L reported 82 junctions from topology
critical_findings.impact: The junction count metric used in Phase L is semantically different from the campaign metric

critical_findings.title: OpenDRIVE size discrepancy
critical_findings.description: Runtime OpenDRIVE is 1.8MB but accepted candidate is 82MB - a 45x difference
critical_findings.impact: The runtime OpenDRIVE is a small subset of the accepted candidate

critical_findings.title: L3 parser logs are synthetic
critical_findings.description: L3 reports parse_status=OK with 0 fatal errors and 0 warnings, but no actual parser logs were captured from CARLA
critical_findings.impact: L3 does not provide independent evidence of parser health

critical_findings.title: L5 visual defect regression has no actual camera data
critical_findings.description: L5 reports PASS but has no actual camera locations, rendered images, or defect checks
critical_findings.impact: L5 does not provide independent evidence of visual defect regression

critical_findings.title: L7 drivability has no actual vehicle spawns
critical_findings.description: L7 reports PASS but has 0 vehicle spawn attempts and 0 successful spawns
critical_findings.impact: L7 does not provide independent evidence of vehicle drivability

critical_findings.title: L9 sensor validation has no actual sensor data
critical_findings.description: L9 reports PASS but has no actual sensor captures or timestamp verification
critical_findings.impact: L9 does not provide independent evidence of sensor validation

critical_findings.title: L10 performance has no actual measurements
critical_findings.description: L10 reports PASS but has 0 for all performance metrics (FPS, frame time, RAM, VRAM)
critical_findings.impact: L10 does not provide independent performance evidence

critical_findings.title: L11 old-vs-new comparison has no actual comparison data
critical_findings.description: L11 reports PASS but has no actual old-vs-new comparison
critical_findings.impact: L11 does not provide independent old-vs-new comparison evidence
